item.ptxt: ISG (1) consists of high precision parts. Observe the following precautions when servicing.
Do not drop or otherwise expose ISG to large shock.
Do not connect ISG to any connector or terminal other than specified one. (Do not use it for power source of accessories, etc.)

After setting ignition “OFF”, relay in auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery) is cut off automatically with a click sound. However, electric discharge continues for a while. Therefore, for servicing “48V+” terminal (2), it is necessary to wait for 3 minutes after the ignition “OFF”.
